Title: I waited a year and all I got was a choose your own adventure book and 120 cards

Messages.Author: JD
Messages.Body:
Gehenna is upon us and the BIG expansion on the horizon. The link
says May 5. So what's with 120 cards in the set? Last I checked,
this is not a big expansion. Maybe because of monetary reasons they
had to...in that case...I should be grateful theirs an expansion at
all. I just don't like being lied to. But considering that White
Wolf said they would never have Gehenna happen in the first place, I
guess this is just par for the course.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

> Gehenna is upon us and the BIG expansion on the horizon. The link
